title: THE BUILD TILES SHOW YOU IN EACH BUILD
why: Following v20.01 (his order of 2026-10-08): the three BUILD tiles in FASHION showed the same little block picture, because a build used to change nothing. They now show your operator in Lean, Broad and Curved, like the outfit and hair tiles do.
now: The FASHION BUILD tiles show you in Lean, Broad and Curved.
